feasibility.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended because Keeley Builders is outside ForgeX's target segment of 10-to-75-staff HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors and already uses an embedded Contractor Foreman lead capture form.

aiDelivery.explanation: Not applicable because no ForgeX automation solution is recommended.

humanReview: No solution is recommended; human review requirements are not applicable.

risks.description: Selling standardized field-service dispatch automations designed for 10-to-75-staff HVAC, plumbing, or electrical trade businesses to a small custom remodeling, handyman, and home building company risks poor workflow fit.

assumptions: The website publishes no service prices, average project values, or lead volumes, and no ForgeX solution is recommended.

qualification.rationale: Keeley Builders is outside ForgeX's target segment of owner-led HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors with 10 to 75 staff who pay for leads. Its website shows it is a small residential remodeling, flooring, painting, starter home construction, and general handyman business, with no evidence of 10–75 staff or paid lead generation, and its Contact Us page already embeds a lead capture form from embed.contractorforeman.com.
